title: Flodesk Review (2026)
intro: Flodesk is evaluated here as email marketing software — Flodesk is a design-led email marketing platform for creators and small brands, emphasizing polished templates, workflows, and optional checkout/selling on higher plans. Pricing moved to subscriber-based tiers (legacy flat unlimited retired for new members Dec 2025): Lite from $25/mo, Pro from $28/mo, Everything from $54/mo at up to 1,000 subscribers (monthly); Free plan for list-growth tools without full sending; 14-day trial. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s email-marketing methodology (ease of use, email creation, automation, segmentation, analytics, deliverability tooling, integrations, scalability, value, AI). It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Flodesk when design-led creator email is the primary job and you want polished templates without hiring a designer.
verdict: Choose Flodesk when design-led creator email is the primary job and you want polished templates without hiring a designer. Compare Kit for creator automations/monetization, Campaign Monitor for design-led agency email, MailerLite for simpler free-tier SMB email, and Beehiiv for newsletter growth platforms. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging on the vendor site before purchase.
